settings.question: How do I choose a size?
settings.answer: Select an available size on the product page. Detailed guidance will be added when final specifications are confirmed.

settings.question: How can I tell if a product is available?
settings.answer: The product page reflects the selected variant and its current Shopify availability.

settings.question: Where can I review my cart?
settings.answer: Open the cart to update quantities before checkout.

settings.question: How can I contact Handsome?
settings.answer: Use the contact form and include an order number if you already have one.

settings.question: Where are shipping and return details?
settings.answer: The store owner will publish shipping and return policies before launch.
